reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in their direct message to confirm that I've noted their standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Brindle rollout: Tuesdays at 15:30 from now on.

I didn't change any calendar or post anywhere else, since they said no action was needed. I also didn't save it separately in gbrain, because gbrain records direct messages automatically and shows them only to that member. A separate entry might have been visible to other people. The schedule stays private to Hollis and won't be mentioned to anyone else.
